description: Name, SMILES (with stereochemistry), molecular formula, exact (monoisotopic) mass, molecular weight, elemental analysis and isotope pattern (m/z). Mixtures and salts are also given per structure. For a drawing (a HexSketch link or CDXML), also its arrows and text: the reagents and conditions written on each arrow.

structure.description: The structure: SMILES (e.g. "CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O"), molfile or CDXML text, or a HexSketch link (https://hexsketch.com/#smiles=... or #cdxml=...). Not a name.
